record.title: APIMig: A Project-Level Cross-Multi-Version API Migration Framework Based on Evolution Knowledge Graph
record.reason: APIMig uses API-evolution knowledge graphs and language models to migrate software projects across library versions, evaluated on Lucene.

record.title: Contrastive Unlearning: A Contrastive Approach to Machine Unlearning
record.reason: Contrastive unlearning removes selected samples or classes from general machine-learning models using embedding objectives, without a biomedical research target.

record.title: Secure and Efficient Watermarking for Latent Diffusion Models in Model Distribution Scenarios
record.reason: The work watermarks latent diffusion models for copyright protection in model-distribution scenarios through model-associated randomness and VAE fine-tuning.

record.title: Diffusion Guided Propagation Augmentation for Popularity Prediction
record.reason: Diffusion-guided propagation augmentation predicts information popularity on Twitter, Weibo and APS cascades for recommendation and trend analysis.

record.title: DASS: A Dual-Branch Attention-based Framework for Trajectory Similarity Learning with Spatial and Semantic Fusion
record.reason: DASS learns geographic trajectory similarity by combining road-network spatial and semantic representations; it does not study biological movement or clinical trajectories.

record.title: AlphaGAT: A Two-Stage Learning Approach for Adaptive Portfolio Selection
record.reason: AlphaGAT selects financial portfolios using market alpha factors and reinforcement-learning graph attention.

record.title: RetroMoE: A Mixture-of-Experts Latent Translation Framework for Single-step Retrosynthesis
record.reason: Retained as an explicit scope boundary: primary molecular synthesis with pharmaceutical relevance, but biomedical-primary versus broader organic-chemistry status remains unresolved. Lack of disease or wet-lab results is not an exclusion reason.

record.title: MTGIB-UNet: A Multi-Task Graph Information Bottleneck and Uncertainty Weighted Network for ADMET Prediction
record.reason: The network predicts molecular ADMET properties governing drug efficacy and safety, using task-specific graph bottlenecks and uncertainty weighting.

record.title: COGRASP: Co-Occurrence Graph Based Stock Price Forecasting
record.reason: COGRASP constructs stock co-occurrence graphs from news and social sources for financial stock-price forecasting.

record.title: KnowMDD: Knowledge-guided Cross Contrastive Learning for Major Depressive Disorder Diagnosis
record.reason: KnowMDD diagnoses major depressive disorder using fMRI functional connectivity, multiple brain atlases and default-mode-network-informed contrastive augmentation.

record.title: Enhancing Chemical Reaction and Retrosynthesis Prediction with Large Language Model and Dual-task Learning
record.reason: ChemDual targets reaction and retrosynthesis prediction for drug discovery and explicitly tests generated compounds for protein-binding affinity through molecular docking.

record.title: Towards Generalizable Neural Simulators: Addressing Distribution Shifts Induced by Environmental and Temporal Variations
record.reason: CoPoNDP addresses concurrent environment and time distribution shifts in a general neural simulator, evaluated across ecology, chemistry, physics and energy rather than focused biological research.

record.title: Asset Pricing with Contrastive Adversarial Variational Bayes
record.reason: Contrastive adversarial variational Bayes models asset-return factors and loadings and evaluates portfolio Sharpe ratios, a financial pricing study.

record.title: Misclassification-driven Fingerprinting for DNNs Using Frequency-aware GANs
record.reason: Frequency-aware GAN fingerprints protect neural-network ownership against model theft, evaluated on image and traffic-sign recognition models.

record.title: FBQuant: FeedBack Quantization for Large Language Models
record.reason: FBQuant quantizes language-model weights for edge-device inference with bounded feedback and a CUDA kernel; it is general model-deployment engineering.

record.title: MA-RAG: Automating Role Engineering for RESTful APIs with Multi-Head Attention and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
record.reason: MA-RAG derives role-based access permissions from RESTful software source code and evaluates role engineering on software systems.

record.title: LPDetective: Dusting the LLM Chats for Prompt Template Abusers
record.reason: LPDetective detects automated prompt-template abuse in chatbot logs through unsupervised clustering and regular-expression extraction.

record.title: Can We Translate Code Better with LLMs and Call Graph Analysis?
record.reason: The method uses call graphs and bridged debuggers to improve language-model translation of software projects across programming languages.

record.title: MMET: A Multi-Input and Multi-Scale Transformer for Efficient PDEs Solving
record.reason: MMET solves multi-input, multi-scale PDE problems for engineering and physical systems; no biomedical objective is identified.

record.title: Fine-Grained and Efficient Self-Unlearning with Layered Iteration
record.reason: SULI refines decision boundaries to forget selected machine-learning data and comply with privacy deletion, not a biomedical modeling task.

record.title: InnateCoder: Learning Programmatic Options with Foundation Models
record.reason: InnateCoder extracts reusable programmatic reinforcement-learning options from foundation-model knowledge and evaluates MicroRTS and Karel the Robot.

record.title: Adaptive Wizard for Removing Cross-Tier Misconfigurations in Active Directory
record.reason: The work optimizes administrator interactions to remove attack paths and cross-tier security misconfigurations in Windows Active Directory.

record.title: Think Twice Before Adaptation: Improving Adaptability of DeepFake Detection via Online Test-Time Adaptation
record.reason: T2A adapts deepfake detectors at inference using uncertainty-aware negative learning and parameter masking, addressing manipulated-media detection rather than biomedical analysis.

record.title: Solving Copyright Infringement on Short Video Platforms: Novel Datasets and an Audio Restoration Deep Learning Pipeline
record.reason: The audio restoration pipeline separates added background music from original soundtracks to detect short-video copyright infringement.

record.title: Disentangled and Personalized Representation Learning for Next Point-of-Interest Recommendation
record.reason: The method recommends the next geographic point of interest using disentangled contextual and personal movement preferences.

record.title: Diffusion-aware Censored Gaussian Processes for Demand Modelling
record.reason: Censored Gaussian processes model substitution-driven unmet demand for sales, bike sharing and electric-vehicle charging services.

record.title: BinMetric: A Comprehensive Binary Code Analysis Benchmark for Large Language Models
record.reason: BinMetric benchmarks language models on compiled-software reverse engineering, including decompilation and binary lifting.

record.title: PDDFormer: Pairwise Distance Distribution Graph Transformer for Crystal Material Property Prediction
record.reason: PDDFormer predicts periodic crystal-material properties on Materials Project and JARVIS-DFT; the atomic structures are materials-science targets, not biological molecules or physiology.

record.title: MTPNet: Multi-Grained Target Perception for Unified Activity Cliff Prediction
record.reason: MTPNet predicts molecular activity cliffs using target-protein and binding-pocket semantics, directly studying compound-protein interactions for drug optimization.

record.title: LogiCase: Effective Test Case Generation from Logical Description in Competitive Programming
record.reason: LogiCase generates software test cases from competitive-programming specifications via context-free grammars with counters.

record.title: PeSANet: Physics-encoded Spectral Attention Network for Simulating PDE-Governed Complex Systems
record.reason: PeSANet integrates local physical operators with spectral attention to forecast general PDE-governed complex systems, without a biological or clinical research question.
